title: Following up, and how to read a silence

videos.script: You apply, and nothing happens. A week later, still nothing. {{nothing}} This is the most common outcome of an application, and it is the one that does the most damage, because people read it as a verdict on themselves. {{damage}} Most of the time, silence means something much less personal: the role was filled, the budget moved, or nobody has opened the inbox. {{less}} This lesson decides when to follow up and what to write, what a silence usually means, and when to stop waiting and move the attention elsewhere.
